payload.text: ISSUE:0658, the estate page's plan usage (3.2.7 under decision 76; hv in ic's session, 2026-10-27: "Ok, do 1 and 2."). v2 is banked at refs/bank/ic/0658/v2 (blob 29282d37ceb3, patch-id 3534a4ebafa3) over cc's scratch tip e22661b78, Part B's tree, from tmp/wt-ic-0658, whose index tree 8fb60935efd9 equals the bank over e22661b78 in a temp index, and ic reported it READY to vc at 08:26Z by ic's clock. It supersedes v1 (refs/bank/ic/0658/v1, blob 876b862b11c2, kept), which vc had accepted and which would have reddened the judge: intentsvcs/tests/one_clock.rs bans `Instant::now` in every src and tests file but daemon_log.rs and estate/clock.rs, and v1's census.rs called it three times for the schedule, not twice as this item first said. v2 changes census.rs alone. The schedule is counted in census ticks with no clock read: `ticks_left` drops by one on each whole tick, a read is due at zero with an armed ask, and after a read it is the wait rounded up to whole ticks, plus one when the read came between ticks, so no wait is short; a unit arm in census.rs pins it. Before READY: the clock-needle grep on the bank printed nothing (v1's counts three), a one_clock stand-in over every crate's src and tests is clean, the bank touches no shipped .sh, .json or .yml (exit_code_consumers) and no dispatch-table row (populations), rustfmt passes against a planted control, and cc's 0657 v2, then wp02-v1, then 0658 v2 apply in order over e22661b78. The rest of v1 stands: usage::carry, usage::next_wait (READ_EVERY five minutes, doubling to WAIT_CAP an hour, never sooner than a 429's Retry-After; an HTTP-date Retry-After falls back to doubling), EndpointFailure::Throttled and the AT-02.6 file's new arms. The judge owes intentsvcs's and intentd's suites, fmt, both clippy legs and CI's doc command (new intra-doc links); the landing chain owes AC-02.6's wording, AT-02.6 re-cited with the new arms in both files, and design.md's Primary paragraph. No CHANGELOG hunk; vc has the line. No push, no release.
